title: Abstract machine run
statement: Let $m,d$ be natural numbers, let $\Lambda$ be a type of states, let $A$ assign an instruction to each state, let an oracle assign a Boolean answer to each of $d$ deciders and each finite bit string, and fix an input bit string $x$. Starting from a configuration $a$, the configuration after $n$ steps is the result of iterating the one-step transition exactly $n$ times.
hypotheses_covered: $A$ assigns an instruction to every state

An input bit string $x$ is fixed
